children.text: Public behaviour is correct and typed
children.criterion: 1 only when the diff's public API is typed and the claimed behaviour is exercised by a test.

children.text: Formatting, lint, and structure are clean
children.criterion: 1 only when black/ruff (or the repo equivalent) pass on the changed files.

children.text: Every code change adds or updates a test
children.criterion: 1 only when a failing-before/passing-after test covers the change; no test weakened.

children.text: The suite passes at the head SHA
children.criterion: Autofilled from the pre-merge tests gate; 1 only when the suite is green or a recorded waiver exists.

children.text: Acceptance commands were run and their output recorded
children.criterion: 1 only when the PR body carries the exact command and observed output the reviewer can re-run.

children.text: Reported numbers name an artifact and its manifest SHA
children.criterion: 1 only when every number in the PR cites an artifact path plus manifest SHA.

children.text: Frozen protocol/config files are untouched or amended
children.criterion: 1 only when the diff touches no frozen file, or a supervisor amendment names the change.

children.text: No selection on the test horizon
Tests were only strengthened across the cycle
Any protocol change has an amendment record
children.criterion: 1 only when a protocol-affecting change is accompanied by an amendment record with justification.

children.text: New artifacts carry a manifest with SHA, seeds, and data hashes
children.criterion: 1 only when every new artifact has a manifest recording commit SHA, seeds, versions, and data hashes.
Autofilled from the artifacts-complete gate; 1 only when every declared file hash matches.

children.text: Every new number has a CLAIMS.json entry
children.criterion: 1 only when each new number in prose/paper maps to a claims entry and an artifact.

children.text: The claims registry is traceable to the audited tag
Only paths in the task brief's scope changed
children.criterion: 1 only when no protected path or out-of-scope file is modified.

children.text: The change is one reviewable unit
children.criterion: 1 only when the diff is a single coherent change with no drive-by edits.

children.text: Residual risk and uncertainty are stated
children.criterion: 1 only when the PR names the residual risk and what was not verified.

children.text: No untested code path is claimed as working
children.criterion: 1 only when every claimed behaviour has an exercised path or an explicit untested caveat.
